## F — Defensive driving, attention and fatigue
Research index: 38 original C facts and 23 continuation or confusable C2 facts cover Defensive driving, attention and fatigue.
Exam index: part A cites cover edition, publisher frontmatter and the physical testing page; no passing percentage or time limit is asserted.
VERIFY: ID-DRIVINGTASK-PERCENT — official percentage not printed; ID-DRIVINGTASK-TIME — official time limit unlocated; ID-DRIVINGTASK-EFFECTIVE — effective date unestablished.
VERIFY: ID-DRIVINGTASK-DYNAMIC — Current phone-law classification and penalties, course registration availability and vehicle-specific airbag hand placement require their appropriate official context.
VERIFY: ID-DRIVINGTASK-MARKET — demand research missing; ID-DRIVINGTASK-COMPETITORS — competitor research missing.
Every open item stays assigned to the evidence or research owner in its originating chunk. Pedagogic priorities are not official topic weights.
VERIFY: ID-STARTING-SIGNAL-TIMING — Physical page eighty-seven gives five seconds or one hundred feet for starting from a curb, entering a parking space or changing lanes without resolving which measure applies in each context. Other accepted source sections provide maneuver-specific timing. The procedure is covered, but this unqualified alternative is not taught as a universal timing rule; scope needs reconciliation.
VERIFY: ID-DRIVER-ERROR-STATISTIC — The greater-than-ninety-percent driver-error assertion on physical page eighty-six has no study, date, denominator or causal method in the staged text. Withheld as an unverified statistic.
VERIFY: ID-SCANNING-SPLIT-SENTENCE — The concluding side-scanning instruction continues from physical page eighty-nine onto ninety with a warning that other drivers may run a light. The local complete side-scanning instruction is covered; the complete cross-page sentence and its rationale remain a binding-span debt.
VERIFY: ID-BLIND-SPOT-VISUAL — The blind-spot illustration referenced on physical page ninety has not received semantic visual review. The text definition and shoulder-check rule are source-bound; graphic interpretation remains unresolved.
VERIFY: ID-PHONE-LAW-CURRENT-AUTHORITY — Physical page ninety-two describes a texting infraction, a hands-free exception, no points, a fine and a commercial-only moving-violation classification. Present legal scope and consequences are not independently established in this frozen-handbook pass. Withhold those legal classifications and any broad hands-free permission until exact current official legal authority is reconciled.
VERIFY: ID-TEXTING-RISK-MULTIPLIER — The six-times texting-versus-impaired-driving comparison spanning physical pages ninety-two and ninety-three lacks a study, date, metric and population in the staged text. It is withheld rather than taught as a universal risk ratio.
VERIFY: ID-ALIVE25-CURRENT-REGISTRATION — Physical page ninety-four names the course registration site, but present offering dates, fees and working registration access were not checked. The source-described course purpose and age range do not establish present availability.
